title: limnochloa acutangula
intro: Limnochloa acutangula, commonly known as Water Spangle-grass, is a type of aquatic plant belonging to the Poaceae family. It is known for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Limnochloa acutangula include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it a potential treatment for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
